# jamfplatform_security_cloud_ztna_grouped_gateway (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Security Cloud ZTNA grouped gateway by ID or by name. Use it to resolve the ID a custom DNS zone name server needs.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Create the API integration with **Platform environment** scope (preferred) or **Tenant** scope, then grant it the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Secure enterprise access | Zero-Trust Network Access (ZTNA) | Read | `ztna` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a grouped gateway by ID.
data "jamfplatform_security_cloud_ztna_grouped_gateway" "by_id" {
  id = "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"
}

# Or by name.
data "jamfplatform_security_cloud_ztna_grouped_gateway" "by_name" {
  name = "EU Egress"
}

output "eu_egress_members" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_security_cloud_ztna_grouped_gateway.by_name.gateway_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Grouped gateway ID to look up. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Grouped gateway name to look up. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the grouped gateway was created.
- `gateway_ids` (List of String) IDs of the member gateways, in priority order.
- `required_gateway_stability` (String) How long a recovered member must stay healthy before traffic returns to it.
- `routing_strategy` (String) Which member a device uses: `Nearest`, `Random` or `First available`.
- `tenant_ids` (List of String) IDs of the tenants granted access to this grouped gateway.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
